title: Time-series momentum on FX majors, 1/3/12-month lookbacks, monthly hold
source: Hurst, Ooi & Pedersen (2017), A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing, Journal of Portfolio Management 44(1)
why: The paper's time-series momentum rule: the sign of the 1, 3 and 12-month return, held for a month. Lookbacks mapped to 21, 63 and 252 trading days. Overlaps the rejected 20-futures TSMOM test (research/futures_tsmom.py), which used lookbacks 21/63/126/252 with volatility sizing; this spec is FX only, sign rule, no sizing, and tests the paper's own monthly hold
